description.p: ZPLab is a visual label designer and ZPL editor for ZPL-compatible printers. Drag text, barcodes, shapes and images onto the canvas while the generated ZPL updates beside it and stays editable, with syntax highlighting and a reference for every ZPL II command.

Existing ZPL comes in as editable source rather than a one-way import: untouched commands, whitespace and comments survive the round trip, and an edit regenerates only what it affects, from a single object up to every page.

ul.li: Visual canvas with layers, alignment guides, serial counters, shapes, images and graphic symbols
28 barcode symbologies, with dedicated GS1-128 and GS1 DataMatrix modes
GS1 content assembled from Application Identifiers, checked per field and against the combination rules
EAN/UPC fields validated as you type, with a live length counter and the computed check digit
Typed payloads for QR Code, Data Matrix and Aztec: URLs, Wi-Fi, contacts, email, phone, SMS and coordinates, plus GS1 Digital Links
Batch printing: map label variables to CSV, Excel or database columns and print one label per row
Printing over raw TCP, the system print queue, or USB
An optional second rendering of the label, from Labelary or from the connected printer's own firmware, to compare against the canvas
An MCP server that lets a local AI assistant read, build and validate labels, and edit the open design directly
32 interface languages, light and dark theme
MIT-licensed, with no account and no backend
